summary: Implement a ticketed specification on one integration branch by scheduling ready work and validating each integrated dependency.

supporting_disposition.reason: Preserve source UI metadata and invocation policy.
Copy repository MIT license and attribution into derived package.

deltas.reason: Unlock a dependent only after its prerequisite integrates and relevant checks pass on the shared branch.
deltas.tradeoff: Reduces apparent concurrency while preventing work on rejected intermediate states.

deltas.reason: Include shared files and unstable contracts as real constraints alongside ticket edges.
deltas.tradeoff: Requires a little coordinator state beyond the source graph.

deltas.reason: Serialize merges and rerun contract-relevant checks before accepting completion.
deltas.tradeoff: Adds integration work that per-ticket passing tests cannot replace.

deltas.reason: Fix valid in-scope findings and retire worktrees only after ownership and work are accounted for.
deltas.tradeoff: Avoids automatic action on speculative comments or unexamined checkouts.

deltas.change: Adapt Codex packaging without changing invocation
deltas.reason: Omit Claude-only disable-model-invocation and argument-hint keys while preserving explicit-only policy in the copied agents/openai.yaml.
deltas.tradeoff: The study package targets Codex metadata rather than being a byte-identical cross-host manifest.
